pose: 儿童头肩正面，双手低处相握
art_direction: 阿尼亚粉发与小巧发饰保持儿童比例，得体校服和桃色赛璐璐背景中自然轻笑，三勾玉眼清楚。
composition: centered original head-and-shoulders anime avatar; readable iris motifs; circular-crop safe
creative_direction: Show Anya Forger with her recognizable pink bob and small dark hair ornaments, wearing a modest dark school dress with a light collar. Keep her natural child proportions and rounded young face. Her hands meet quietly at the lower edge of the portrait while she gives a small curious smile. Use clean cel shading with peach and cream background planes, keeping the facial marks economical and both eyes clearly open. Avoid adult makeup, exaggerated blush, or a theatrical grin. The hair ornaments remain within the crop, and no school lettering, stuffed toy, or extra character appears. Both visible irises contain a clear red Sharingan design with three small black comma marks and a normal dark pupil; keep bright catchlights and the friendly expression. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
